regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is narrowing: only 5 of 17 themes pass the absolute-trend eligibility gate, and the rotation breadth view is 'narrowing' with one_narrative=false. The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control here (gate_helps=true), so the honest read is a low-conviction, trend-following preference for the two eligible leaders — Banks and Energy — while most of the board (China Tech/EV/Gaming) sits below the gate and should simply be left alone. No theme carries a crowding or one-narrative flag, so no fade or top-call is warranted.
emerging_watch: Watch whether High-Dividend Blue Chips (rank 4, durable_bar 0.65, hurst 'trend', breadth 0.75) widens its breadth further and overtakes Banks in the rotation score — a confirmed handoff into the defensive-income leg would retire the watch; it would also change the regime read from cyclical-leader (Banks/Energy) to defensive-leader.

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the single most constructive eligible theme on the detector's own legs: it is trend-gated (eligible=true), has the highest durability_bar (0.80), a clean hurst_tag of 'trend', and the best breadth (0.90) in the entire set. Its crowding_z of 0.24 also makes it the least crowded of the eligible leaders. This is a staying-power / trend-health read, not a rank alpha call — the rank (2) is only a focus lens.
theses.dissent: Energy leadership is a coincident focus read with no forward return edge; a mean-revert regime (macro_narrative.unscheduled_share is 0.75, headlines dominated by 'markets'/'geopolitics') could rotate leadership away from resources with no warning, and trend-gating only trims volatility, it does not add return.

falsifier.text: H-share Energy falls below the Hang Seng by 5% cumulative before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the rotation leader and is trend-gated (eligible=true) with reasonable durability (0.63) and breadth (0.615), and without a crowding flag (crowded=false). In a narrowing tape where only five themes are eligible, the leader is the least-opposed trend-following candidate. This is a discipline read: stay with the eligible leader, size it defensively.
theses.dissent: Banks' r10 is slightly negative (-0.0088) and durability is only 'mixed' (hurst_tag=mixed, bar 0.63), so its trend-health is weaker than Energy; if the narrow tape keeps tightening, the leader is also the first to get sold when the few eligible names unwind.

falsifier.text: Banks lose the rotation lead (score falls below Energy) AND its trend-gate flips to ineligible before the check-by date

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is scorable (proxy 3033.HK) and sits rank 14 with a negative score and ineligible trend gate. It is the most liquid scorable proxy on the wrong side of the only validated discipline. The avoid lean is the detector's own gate applied: below-gate themes get no trend-following allocation until the gate re-opens.
theses.dissent: China Tech is deeply out of favor and mean-reverting by hurst tag; if the unscheduled-news regime (75% surprise share) turns and mainland stimulus/narrative shifts, this is the classic sharp snap-back candidate — but that is a mean-reversion call the gate actively avoids.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet flips to eligible=true (trend gate re-opens) before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
